comment: ASCND Motion Kit: movement families and the metric bounds that define them (evs/movement_gate.py). [lo, hi], null = no bound. A family marked provisional has bounds from coaching consensus that are not yet checked against a measured clip or a cited study; tighten them from the first reviewed exercise of that family and record the source here. Exercises can override a bound in exercise.json -> movement.qa. Per-family research_notes record what was checked on 2026-11-14 and what is still missing; a cited family may still list individual provisional metrics, which fail as REQUIRES_MANUAL_REVIEW.

press_horizontal.label: Supine horizontal press (bench press, incline/decline press, dumbbell press, floor press)

sources.elbow_flexion_max_deg: Mausehund et al. 2022 JSCR 36(10): peak elbow flexion 101.4 +/- 8.3 deg medium grip, 87.4 wide, 110-114 narrow
sources.humerus_depth_min_deg: Mausehund et al. 2022: humerus -6.2 to -10.8 deg to the thorax frontal plane at the bottom (trained lifters, ~30 deg arch); ASCND allows -22 for a moderate arch
sources.elbow_max_deg: lockout: elbows nearly straight (Starting Strength, Barbell Medicine)
sources.hip_drop_m: glutes stay on the bench (NSCA five points of contact)
sources.wrist_travel_m: bar range of motion chest to lockout

push_up.label: Prone press from the floor

sources.elbow_flexion_max_deg: Su et al. 2026 Front Physiol (doi 10.3389/fphys.2026.1989588): elbow flexion at the lowest push-up position 85.6 +/- 5.3 deg (elite) / 94.2 +/- 7.1 deg (non-elite), 40 male gymnasts, 3D motion capture. Bound requires >=70 deg.
sources.elbow_max_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow extension 0 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound sits inside the envelope; no push-up study reporting the top angle was read, so the metric stays provisional.

push_up.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): torso_lean_min_deg: Su 2026 reports trunk inclination VARIABILITY (2.1 +/- 0.5 vs 3.8 +/- 1.2 deg), not an absolute trunk angle, so no bound was drawn from it. Missing: a study reporting absolute trunk inclination during the push-up, or a measured clip.

press_vertical.label: Overhead press (barbell, dumbbell, machine)

sources.elbow_min_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow flexion 140-150 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound sits inside the envelope; no overhead-press study read.
sources.elbow_max_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow extension 0 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound sits inside the envelope; no overhead-press study read.
sources.wrist_over_head_m: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (shoulder flexion 180 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Full overhead reach is inside the envelope; the 0.05 m clearance itself is coaching consensus, no press study read.

press_vertical.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): standing overhead press abstracts read report ROM comparisons between conditions (barbell vs machine, Korean J Appl Biomech) or model outputs (J Funct Morphol Kinesiol 2025 link-chain model), with no absolute gate-usable shoulder/elbow angles. Missing: full text with absolute angles, or a measured licensed clip. torso_lean_max_deg / hip_drop_m: no source found.

squat.label: Squat (back, front, goblet, air)

sources.knee_min_deg: Schoenfeld 2010 JSCR 24(12):3497-3506: half squats 70-100 deg knee flexion, deep squats >100 deg; Escamilla et al. 2001 MSSE 33(6):984-998 (PMID 11404665): competition squats analysed at 90 deg knee flexion and maximum knee flexion. Bound requires >=80 deg flexion (interior <=100 deg), inside the half-squat band.

squat.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): hip_drop_m: no study found reporting pelvis drop in metres; torso_lean_max_deg: Hales et al. 2009 JSCR 23(9):2574-2580 (PMID 19910816) reports a squat trunk angle of 40.58 +/- 6.29 deg at the sticking point, but the abstract does not state the angle convention (from vertical vs horizontal), so no bound was drawn from it - full text needed; foot_split_m: stance-symmetry check, no study; Escamilla 2001 stance widths (107/142/169% shoulder width) describe foot_spread, not foot_split. No licensed squat clip was on hand for measurement; two user-provided 'squat-pro3' mp4 files exist under ~/workspace/user/files but were NOT measured (provenance/license unverified).

hinge.label: Hip hinge (deadlift, Romanian deadlift, good morning)
hinge.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): Escamilla et al. 2000 MSSE 32(7):1265-1275 (PMID 10912892) abstract read: sumo vs conventional comparisons only (thigh 11-16 deg more horizontal for sumo, trunk 5-10 deg more vertical for sumo), no absolute joint angles; Hales et al. 2009 abstract read: deadlift trunk angle 58.30 +/- 7.15 deg at the sticking point, angle convention unstated in the abstract. Missing: full text of either study with absolute hip/knee/trunk angles at liftoff, or a measured licensed clip. Secondary blog numbers attributed to Hales/Escamilla were seen but NOT used (unverified).

lunge.label: Lunge, split squat, step-up

sources.knee_min_deg: Hofmann et al. 2017 JOSPT 47(1):31-40 (doi 10.2519/jospt.2017.6336): peak lead-limb knee flexion 90 deg (vertical shank, by design) and ~100 deg (shank-forward); trail limb ~100-105 deg. Bound requires >=70 deg flexion (interior <=110 deg), below the observed range.
sources.foot_split_m: Hofmann et al. 2017: stride-length target 75-100% of limb length (mean limb length 84.4 +/- 5.6 cm), i.e. study strides >= ~0.63 m; bound 0.5 m is below the study minimum and only requires a real step forward.

lunge.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): torso_lean_max_deg: Hofmann 2017 varies trunk position (vertical vs forward) but reports no trunk angle in degrees; hip_drop_m: no study found reporting pelvis drop in metres for the lunge. Both stay provisional.

row.label: Bent-over / supported row
row.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): no kinematic study with absolute torso/elbow angles found. Secondary summaries describe Fenwick et al. 2009 (spine loading, 7 men) and Saeterbakken et al. 2015 (EMG, 15 men); neither paper was opened and neither reports gate metrics in the summaries seen. A small 9-player torso-angle comparison (65 vs 40 deg from upright) was seen only in a secondary summary and was NOT used. Missing: a row kinematics study or a measured licensed clip.

pull_vertical.label: Pull-up, lat pulldown

sources.arm_elev_max_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (shoulder flexion 180 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Arms fully overhead at the hang sit inside the envelope; no pull-up study read.
sources.elbow_min_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow flexion 140-150 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound sits inside the envelope; no pull-up study read.

pull_vertical.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): no pull-up / lat-pulldown kinematics study with absolute angles found in search. Missing: a kinematics study or a measured licensed clip.

curl.label: Elbow flexion (biceps curl, hammer curl)

sources.elbow_min_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow flexion 140-150 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound requires >=120 deg flexion, inside the envelope; no curl kinematics study read.
sources.elbow_max_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow extension 0 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound sits inside the envelope; no curl kinematics study read.

curl.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): ACE / ExRx technique guidance (upper arms stationary at the sides, torso upright, full elbow flexion to shoulder height) is qualitative with no angles; no peer-reviewed curl kinematics study with absolute angles found. Missing: a curl kinematics study or a measured licensed clip. No licensed curl clip was on hand.

tricep_extension.label: Elbow extension (overhead / lying / pushdown)

sources.elbow_min_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow flexion 140-150 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound sits inside the envelope; no triceps-extension study read.
sources.elbow_max_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow extension 0 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Bound sits inside the envelope; no triceps-extension study read.

tricep_extension.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): no triceps-extension kinematics study found in search. Missing: a kinematics study or a measured licensed clip.

raise_lateral.label: Lateral raise

sources.elbow_min_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow extension 0 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Near-straight elbows sit inside the envelope; the 'keep elbows nearly straight' cue itself is coaching consensus.

raise_lateral.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): guidance consensus seen in secondary summaries is 'stop at shoulder height, upper arm parallel to the floor' (ACE / ExRx); the primary ACE/ExRx pages were not opened and no peer-reviewed kinematics study with absolute angles was found. arm_elev_max_deg / arm_lateral_frac / torso_lean_max_deg stay provisional. Missing: a kinematics study or a measured licensed clip.

raise_front.label: Front raise

sources.elbow_min_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (elbow extension 0 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Near-straight elbows sit inside the envelope; the 'keep elbows nearly straight' cue itself is coaching consensus.

raise_front.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): guidance consensus seen in secondary summaries is 'stop at shoulder height, upper arm parallel to the floor' (ACE / ExRx); the primary ACE/ExRx pages were not opened and no peer-reviewed kinematics study with absolute angles was found. arm_elev_max_deg / arm_lateral_frac / torso_lean_max_deg stay provisional. Missing: a kinematics study or a measured licensed clip.

calf_raise.label: Calf raise

sources.knee_min_deg: ROM envelope only: AAOS reference values (knee extension 0 deg), via Physiopedia Range of Motion Normative Values (Botman et al. supplement compilation), read 2026-11-14. Straight knees sit inside the envelope; the 'knees stay straight' requirement itself is coaching consensus.

calf_raise.research_notes: 2026-11-14 review (C): search surfaced heel-rise studies reporting EMG, peak-height comparisons across foot positions (Hebert-Losier 2024, The Foot 60:102112), and bone-level ankle ROM (talus dorsiflexion-plantarflexion 34.7 +/- 12.9 deg, PMID 35097392); none gives pelvis rise in metres or a knee-angle bound for the gate. Missing: a study reporting heel-rise height / pelvis rise, or a measured licensed clip.
